Splitify for Android (Android 8.0 / API 26 or later). Installs as an update over any earlier version; your data stays in your Google account.

## Fixes
- **Pending payment requests no longer get stuck.** If the receiver records your payment with their instant **Paid** button, your "awaiting confirmation" request now closes automatically. Requests already stuck this way are cleaned up the next time the receiver opens the event, and they're hidden for the payer straight away.
- **No duplicate requests.** You can't send a second request to the same person while one is still awaiting confirmation, so the same payment can never be confirmed twice.
- **Individual Expenses:** whoever pays for an item now has their own share marked as **covered**, and each person's summary shows Paid, Share and Received separately, so the payer's own part no longer looks like money owed.
- **Settlements table alignment:** the Paid and Received columns now line up in every row.

## Install
Download **Splitify-v1.7.1.apk** below and open it on your Android device.
